item.title: Homelab
item.description:
🚀 My 5‑Year‑Old Homelab: The Ultimate Playground for AI, IaC, and Edge Computing

“A homelab is not a hobby; it’s a laboratory for the future.” – Inspired by the ethos of the open‑source community.

For five years, I’ve been building, tearing down, and re‑building a lab that’s become my personal sandbox for everything from AI research to Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) experimentation. It’s a living, breathing ecosystem that pushes the limits of my hardware, software, and curiosity. Below is a deep dive into the heart of my homelab, the tech stack that fuels it, and how each component is a stepping‑stone toward mastering tomorrow’s computing paradigms.
